title: M3-3 DvP Phase 4: frozen manifest, 2025 conditional holdout, decisions, model card, prospective 2026 freeze
objective: Phase 4 of the owner's DvP specification (OWN-074). Freeze the Phase 3 method in a manifest (code and config hashes, frozen candidates, audit run, evaluation protocol and predeclared decision rules) before 2025 is forecast; a holdout stage that refuses to run unless every frozen hash matches; evaluate the frozen candidates (D/ST B06, B00 elsewhere, plus each position's best DvP for information) on 2025 as CONDITIONALLY_HELD_OUT with parameters fit through 2024; label each position and the whole PROMISING, INCONCLUSIVE, NOT_USEFUL or BLOCKED by the predeclared rule; write MODEL_CARD.md and a prospective 2026 freeze for confirmation on games completed after it. Research only: no weight, service or production change; any production use needs the owner.

review.summary: Read the specification's Phase 4 (frozen manifest, CONDITIONALLY_HELD_OUT labeling, prospective confirmation, decision labels per position and globally) and section 12, the Phase 3 receipts and frozen candidates, and the stage guard. 2025 exposure: descriptive only (v0 and Phase A used 2016-2025 for repeatability); no 2025 forecast, outcome or parameter entered model selection, which used development folds 2017-2023 and was confirmed on 2024.

plan.summary: 1) dvp.py freeze writes config/dvp/frozen.json: SHA-256 of the method files (walkforward.py, lab.py, asof.py, observations.py, dvp.py, base/backtest configs, frozen candidates), the audit run's output hashes and targets index, the protocol (RMSE, week-block bootstrap, seed, practical minimum) and the decision rule, plus the prospective 2026 window. 2) backtest --stage holdout runs only when every frozen hash matches the files on disk; parameters fit on 2016-2024; candidates evaluated on 2025; decisions by the predeclared rule (PROMISING if the candidate is a DvP variant meeting the minimum in development, validation and holdout; NOT_USEFUL if the best DvP misses the minimum in all three; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; BLOCKED on any integrity failure). 3) Tests for the holdout guard. 4) MODEL_CARD.md, PROSPECTIVE_2026.md, registry decisions, records.
